A toggle on the panel limits output to changes only. Place as a bpatcher from the us.1bitprobability clipping (Upshot/clippings/MISC). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_2chanpanner.use_when: stereo panner. Multi-channel spatializer — feed mono signal + position; outputs N panned channels. Use for fixed-channel-count spatialisation; for arbitrary configurations reach for ambisonics packages.

upshot_4chanpanner.use_when: Pans stereo audio around four speakers in a circle. Two audio inlets (L, R) plus a 0–127 position inlet; the position is an endless rotary around the ring. Outlets: 4 speaker signals. Equal-power curve from a lookup table. Place as a bpatcher from the us.4chanpanner clipping (Upshot/clippings/ROUTING). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_7bitprobability.use_when: Outputs 0 or 1, with the chance set per input value in a drawn table. Inlet: bang. Outlet: 0 or 1. Draw the chance of a 1 for each test value 0–127 in the panel's itable (hovering shows X = value, Y = probability). Place as a bpatcher from the us.7bitprobability clipping (Upshot/clippings/MISC). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_8chanpanner.use_when: Pans stereo audio around eight speakers in a circle. Two audio inlets (L, R) plus a 0–127 position inlet; the position is an endless rotary around the ring. Outlets: 8 speaker signals. Place as a bpatcher from the us.8chanpanner clipping (Upshot/clippings/ROUTING). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_autocontrol.digest: trigger a bang, toggle or random value
upshot_autocontrol.use_when: trigger a bang, toggle or random value.

upshot_collatz.digest: sequencer based on the Collatz Conjecture
upshot_collatz.use_when: sequencer based on the Collatz Conjecture.

upshot_collide.digest: a sequencer based on Newton's cradle
upshot_collide.use_when: a sequencer based on Newton's cradle.

upshot_echternach.digest: a sequencer based on the Procession of Echternach
upshot_echternach.use_when: a sequencer based on the Procession of Echternach.

upshot_fauxstereo.digest: fake stereo output from mono input
upshot_fauxstereo.use_when: fake stereo output from mono input.

upshot_granular.use_when: Granulates incoming audio into clouds of short grains. The file is upshot_granular.maxpat (its refpage and help file are named upshot_granulator). Inlets 7, outlets 2 (stereo). Built on the rgrano granulator abstraction (ulto_rgrano_li.maxpat) with omx.peaklim~ on the output. Place as a bpatcher from the us.granulator clipping (Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_looper.use_when: Records and loops audio with stretching, pitch shift and randomizing. Inlets: audio L, audio R, record (bang), loop recording (0/1), play/stop (0/1), speed/direction, reset speed (bang), loop start, loop end, random (0/1), timestretching (0–6), random speed, buffer size, pitch shift, volume. Outlets: audio L, audio R, sync bang. Built on record~ and groove~. Place as a bpatcher from the us.looper clipping (Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_lpcontrol.use_when: Turns a Novation Launchpad into sliders, pads, XY pads and a keyboard. The file is upshot_lpcontrol.maxpat (its refpage and help file are named upshot_launchpadcontrol). No inlets or outlets: it talks to the Launchpad over MIDI itself and offers sliders, buttons, XY pads and a keyboard. Tested with Launchpad S, Mini and Mini MK3. Place as a bpatcher from the us.launchpadcontrol clipping (Upshot/clippings/MIDI). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_morse.digest: a sequencer based on morse code
upshot_morse.use_when: a sequencer based on morse code.

upshot_musicaltyping.digest: use computer keyboard to make music
upshot_musicaltyping.use_when: use computer keyboard to make music.

upshot_noisegenerator.use_when: Generates white or pink noise with a filter. The file is upshot_noisegenerator.maxpat (its refpage and help file are named upshot_noise). noise~ or pink~ through matrix~ into biquad~, with noise-type and filter-type menus; 3 inlets, 2 outlets. Place as a bpatcher from the us.noise clipping (Upshot/clippings/MISC). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_reversestretch.use_when: Records audio, then plays it reversed and stretched. Inlets: audio L, audio R, record (0/1), play/stop (0/1), transpose semitones (0–127), volume. Outlets: audio L, audio R. Records into a buffer and plays it back reversed with groove~. Place as a bpatcher from the us.reversestretch clipping (Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_ringmodulator.use_when: Shifts the frequencies of stereo audio (labeled ring modulator). Inlets: audio L, audio R, state (0/1), frequency (0–127, scaled to 1–1000 Hz), volume. Outlets: audio L, audio R. Despite the name it runs freqshift~ (a frequency shifter), with an option to enable negative sidebands, into omx.peaklim~. Place as a bpatcher from the us.ringmodulator clipping (Upshot/clippings/AUDIO EFFECTS). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

upshot_scale.digest: Map values to an output range
upshot_scale.use_when: Map values to an output range.

upshot_transport.use_when: Controls Max's global transport with tap tempo and time signature. Inlets: transport state (0/1), bar, beat, tap tempo (bang), time signature beats, time signature unit (0–4), reset (bang), volume. Outlets: state, bars/beats list, BPM, time signature, pulse bang. Wraps Max's transport so other Upshot modules stay in step. Place as a bpatcher from the us.transport clipping (Upshot/clippings/MIDI). Upshot controls take and output 0–127 floats; hover over inlets to read their roles. By Benjamin Van Esser.

vector_3ch_out.digest: Similar to Vsynths' Render. You must have only one, even if you have multiple patches open.
vector_3ch_out.use_when: Sends Vsynth vector X, Y and brightness signals to audio outputs. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: XY; B. Outlets: none. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] b_enable [boolean] preview [boolean] brightness [0. - 1.] delay [0. - 40.] outputs [(1 - 8) (1 - 8) (1 - 8)]. Only one per Max session. For driving a real oscilloscope, vector monitor or laser through an audio interface; choose output channels 1-8 per signal. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_3d_displacement.digest: When auto_rotation enabled, these control the speed instead of the angle.
vector_3d_displacement.use_when: Pushes vector drawings in depth by a signal, with rotation on three axes. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY; ZM (~). Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): x [-2. - 2.] y [-2. - 2.] z [0. - 1.] zm [-2. - 5.] rotx / roty / rotz [-360. - 360.] artox / aroty / arotz [boolean] speedx / speedy / speedz [-1. - 1.]. The right inlet signal sets Z displacement; auto_rotation turns angle controls into speeds. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_audio2tex.digest: Transforms XY B signals into a texture that you can mix with Vsynth's videosynthesis modules.
vector_audio2tex.use_when: Draws Vsynth vector X/Y/brightness signals into a texture for video mixing. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: XY; B. Outlets: Texture. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. The bridge from the vector modules to the texture modules. The readme says it works better at 96 kHz. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_brightness_merger.digest: Combine two brightness signals into one for more complex brightness modulations.
vector_brightness_merger.use_when: Combines two vector brightness signals into one. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: B; B. Outlets: B. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_cropper.digest: Clips the signal. Like EdgeFade without Brightness modulation.
vector_cropper.use_when: Clips a vector drawing at its left, right, top and bottom edges. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): r [0. 1.] l [0. 1.] b [0. 1.] t [0. 1.] lockH [boolean] lockV [boolean]. Like vector_edge_fade without brightness control. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_crossfader.digest: Morph or Mix two XY or XYB signals in different ways.
vector_crossfader.use_when: Crossfades, mixes or morphs between two vector drawings. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY / XYB; XY / XYB. Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): crossfade [0. - 1.] mode [boolean] switch [0. - 120.] alpha [boolean]. Use vector_xyb_compose first to bundle X/Y and brightness into one cord. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_cube_generator.digest: When auto_rotation enable, these control the speed instead of the angle.
vector_cube_generator.use_when: Generates a rotating 3D wireframe cube as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / SM. Outlets: XY; SYNC. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 240.] x [-2. - 2.] y [-2. - 2.] scale [0. - 1.] sm [-2. - 5.] rotx / roty / rotz [-360. - 360.] artox / aroty / arotz [boolean] speedx / speedy / speedz [-1. - 1.]. Auto_rotation turns angle controls into rotation speeds. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_degrader.digest: Lock Y steps to be the same as X
vector_degrader.use_when: Quantizes vector X/Y positions into steps, like a bit-crusher for drawings. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): mix [0. - 1.] stepx [1. - 25.] stepy [1. - 25.] scale [0. - 1.] lock [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_displacement.digest: Apply simple spatial transformations and modulate them.
vector_displacement.use_when: Moves, scales and rotates a vector drawing, with modulation inputs. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY; XM (~); YM (~); SM (~); RM (~). Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): x [-2. - 2.] y [-2. - 2.] xm [-2. - 2.] ym [-2. - 2.] scale [0. - 5.] sm [-2. - 5.] angle [-1. - 1.] am [-3.14 - 3.14]. Modulation inputs accept signals or textures. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_edge_fade.digest: Brightness In has a pre-patched "full brightness" signal in case nothing is plugged in >>
vector_edge_fade.use_when: Fades a vector drawing's brightness to black near its edges. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / B; SYNC. Outlets: B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): r [0. 1.] l [0. 1.] b [0. 1.] t [0. 1.]. Brightness input defaults to full when nothing is connected. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_fisheye.use_when: Applies a fisheye lens distortion to a vector drawing. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): aperture [-1. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_flip&swap.use_when: Mirrors a vector drawing horizontally or vertically, or swaps X and Y. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): flipx [boolean] flipy [boolean] swap [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_grid_generator.digest: Inputs are pre-patched. This signal is also modulating Y and B until something is plugged into their modulation in.
vector_grid_generator.use_when: Generates a grid by rapidly switching vertical and horizontal rasters. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XM In (texture/signal); YM In (texture/signal); BM In (texture/signal). Outlets: XY; B; SYNC. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 120.] speedH [-1. - 1.] speedV [-1. - 1.] dir [0. - 1.] lines [1. - 160.] xm [-2. - 2.] ym [-2. - 2.] bm [0. -1.] binv [boolean]. Modulation inputs take signals or textures; with nothing connected, an internal signal modulates Y and brightness. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_modules.digest: The only officially supported way of adding modules is through this custom menu. To grab it, right-click on an unlocked patch and PasteFrom/Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat.
vector_modules.use_when: Shows the menu of Vsynth vector modules for adding them to a patch. A menu patch, not a processing module. Vsynth's supported way to add vector modules is Paste From > Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_noise_generator.digest: Use Threshold and Smooth to fade the line between the dots.
vector_noise_generator.use_when: Generates random points in 2D or 3D, joined by lines, as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): bang refresh [1. - 240.] speed [0. - 240.] scale [0. - 1.] points [0. - 100.] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.] mode [boolean] animation [boolean] rota [boolean] rotb [boolean]. Bang makes new points; threshold and smooth fade the connecting lines. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_outline_generator.digest: Real-time image tracer with brightness-band selector and definition. Remember to download the cv.jit Package to use this module.
vector_outline_generator.use_when: Traces outlines of a video image into vector drawing signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / Texture In. Outlets: XY; B; SYNC. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] refresh [1. - 240.] band [0. - 1.] detail [0. - 100.] threshold [0. - 1.]. Requires the cv.jit package. band and detail pick the brightness range and amount of outline. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_poly_raster_generator.digest: Inputs are pre-patched. This signal is also modulating Y and B until something is plugged into their modulation in.
vector_poly_raster_generator.use_when: Generates a polygon-shaped raster scan as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XM (texture/signal); YM (texture/signal); BM (texture/signal). Outlets: XY; B; SYNC. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 120.] speed [-1. - 1.] phase [-1. - 1.] smooth [0. - 10.] vertex [1. - 420.] cycles [1. - 60.] angle [-360. - 360.] xm [-2. - 2.] ym [-2. - 2.] bm [0. -1.] binv [boolean]. Vertex sets polygon sides; modulation inputs take signals or textures. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_preview.digest: Resizable preview window with XY and B inputs & outputs.
vector_preview.use_when: Shows vector X/Y and brightness signals in a resizable preview window. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY; B. Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. Inputs pass straight through to its outputs, so it can sit anywhere in a chain. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_raster_generator.digest: Inputs are pre-patched. This signal is also modulating Y and B until something is plugged into their modulation in.
vector_raster_generator.use_when: Generates parallel or diagonal raster lines as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XM In (texture/signal); YM In (texture/signal); BM In (texture/signal). Outlets: XY; B; SYNC. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 120.] phase [0. - 1.] speed [-1. - 1.] dir [0. - 1.] mode [boolean] lines [1. - 160.] xm [-2. - 2.] ym [-2. - 2.] bm [0. -1.] binv [boolean]. A starting point for scan-processor style images; modulation inputs take signals or textures. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_ripples.digest: Sine-wave based ripples with different shapes.
vector_ripples.use_when: Generates sine-based ripple patterns, from stripes to radial shapes, as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): cycles [1. - 10.] phase [0. - 1.] speed [-1. - 1.] morph [0. - 1.] shape [0. - 1.] rotation [0. - 360.] distortion [-1. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_scale_bias.digest: Adjust the amplitude and offset of a mono signal. Multiply (scale) a signal for a constant value, then add (bias) a value.
vector_scale_bias.use_when: Scales and offsets a single vector signal, such as brightness. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / B. Outlets: B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): scale [-1. - 2.] bias [-1. - 1.]. Multiplies by scale, then adds bias. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_sketcher.use_when: Records mouse drawings as looping frame animations output as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: XY; B; SYNC; Texture. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 60.] brush_width [1. - 20.] animation [0 - 3] speed [0. - 240.] previews [boolean] play // restarts animation restart // start over. Stores up to 240 frames with three playback modes. Requires the cv.jit package. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_sosci.digest: Automatically loads James Ball's "Sosci" vst  with some custom presets for the simulator.
vector_sosci.use_when: Loads James Ball's Sosci oscilloscope simulator plug-in with Vsynth presets. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY; B. Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): open smoothing [0. - 1.] focus [0. - 1. ] mode [0 - 2]. Requires the free Sosci VST from its author, installed separately. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_stretcher.digest: Stretch and compress with modulation inputs. Adjusting X and Y or XM and YM at the same time results in scaling.
vector_stretcher.use_when: Stretches or compresses a vector drawing on X and Y, with modulation. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY; XM (~); YM (~). Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): x [0. - 10.] y [0. - 10.] xm [-4. - 4.] ym [-4. - 4.] lock [boolean] lockM [boolean]. Changing X and Y together scales the drawing. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_tex2audio.digest: Transforms a texture into a polar/bipolar mono audio signal
vector_tex2audio.use_when: Reads a texture into a mono audio signal for modulating vector drawings. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: SYNC; Texture. Outlets: + SIG; +/- SIG. Outputs a 0-1 and a -1 to 1 version; takes a SYNC input from a raster generator. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_text_generator.digest: Use the Title & Outline Generator combo to get fonts, text formatting and animations!
vector_text_generator.use_when: Draws three short lines of text as vector signals. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable1 / enable2 / enable3 [boolean] text1 / text2 / text3 [up to 13 characters] x1 / x2 / x3 [-2. - 2.] y1 / y2 / y3 [-2. - 2.] scale1 / scale2 / scale3 [0. - 2.] angle1 / angle2 / angle3 [-360. - 360.] refresh [0. - 240.] switch [0. - 240.]. Up to 13 characters per line. Pair vs_title_generator with vector_outline_generator for fonts and animation. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_translation_scale.digest: Carry out translation and scale operations.
vector_translation_scale.use_when: Moves and scales a vector drawing. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): x [-2. - 2.] y [-2. - 2.] scale [0. - 2.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_twirl.digest: "Twirls" the image around its center point. Control the amount of distortion and its phase at a constant speed.
vector_twirl.use_when: Twists a vector drawing around its center. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XY. Outlets: XY. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): amt [-10. - 10.] speed [-1. - 1.]. Amt sets distortion; speed animates it. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_wobbulator_generator.digest: Mix of Raster and Displacement modules with some twist that resembles the historic Wobbulator built by Nam June Paik and Shuya Abe.
vector_wobbulator_generator.use_when: Generates raster lines with displacement, inspired by the Paik-Abe Wobbulator. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: Control In / XM In (texture/signal); YM In (texture/signal); SM In (texture/signal); BM In (texture/signal). Outlets: XY; B. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): refresh [1. - 120.] lines [1. - 160.] xm [-2. - 2.] ym [-2. - 2.] sm [-3.14 - 3.14] cx [boolean] cy [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vector_xyb_compose.digest: Merge XY and B signals into one patchcoord.Specially useful before mixing modules such as Crossfade
vector_xyb_compose.use_when: Bundles vector X/Y and brightness signals into one multichannel cord. Vsynth vector-synthesis module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vtr_menu.maxpat`). Vector signals are audio: XY is a 2-channel multichannel cord, B is brightness; SYNC outputs sync the scan. Inlets: XY; B. Outlets: XYB. Needed before mixing modules such as vector_crossfader. Brightness defaults to full when unconnected. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_3bandsplit.digest: Splits the incoming texture into 3 different bands of brightness.
vs_3bandsplit.use_when: Splits a texture into three outputs by brightness band. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: unlabelled; unlabelled; unlabelled. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_alpha_blend.digest: Replace darks and brigthess sections of a texture by other two.
vs_alpha_blend.use_when: Replaces dark and bright parts of a texture with two other textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Alpha Texture In; Replace Whites In; Replace Blacks In. Outlets: Texture Out. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_alpha_blend_2.digest: Similar to Duotoner but tinted with other textures instead of just color.
vs_alpha_blend_2.use_when: Tints dark and light parts of an image with two other textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Replace White Texture; Replace Black Texture. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [boolean] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Like vs_duotoner, but with textures instead of flat colors. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_audio2video.use_when: Turns incoming audio into a scanned video image. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Audio In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): on [boolean] mode [boolean] interp [boolean]. Turns audio on automatically. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_band_splitter.digest: Extracts a shade of gray between 2 thresholds.
vs_band_splitter.use_when: Keeps only the gray shades between two brightness thresholds. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Texture Out Inv. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [boolean] time [0 - 10] speed [-1.5 - 1.5] sync_invert [boolean] offset [-1. - 1.] range [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Band position can be animated with the sync timer. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_blendmode_mixer.digest: Mix two textures with different operations.
vs_blendmode_mixer.use_when: Mixes two textures with one of twelve blend modes. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] in1 / in2 [-1. - 1.] master [0. - 1.] blend_mode [0 - 11]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_camera_fm.digest: Camera module with displacement texture map input.
vs_camera_fm.use_when: Brings in webcam video warped by a displacement texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Distorted Out; Bypassed Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] xm[0. - 1.] ym[0. -1.]. Second output passes the undistorted image. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_camera_s.digest: Webcam Input. Use several instances of this module with a different camera each.
vs_camera_s.use_when: Brings live webcam video into a Vsynth patch as a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] invx [boolean]. Use one instance per camera. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_capture.digest: Record a video with embbed audio in real time.
vs_capture.use_when: Records the video output with stereo audio to a movie file. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In; Audio In 1; Audio In 2. Outlets: none. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): codec [0 - 3] or name fps [1 - 60] write [boolean]. Choose codec and frame rate in the module. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_cartopol.use_when: Remaps a texture from Cartesian to polar coordinates. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Pairs with vs_poltocar. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_chemical_osc.digest: Using the "bang" output of the Spacebang clipping to reset the reaction by pressing the spacebar key.
vs_chemical_osc.use_when: Generates evolving patterns from a Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction simulation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: unlabelled. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] bang reset mode [boolean] speedlim [0. - 1.] disrupt [0. - 1.] speed [0. - 1.] rot [-1. - 1.] x [-1. - 1.] y [-1. - 1.] zoom [0.99 - 1.]. Bang reset restarts the reaction. Works alone or with a connected video source. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_chroma_key.digest: Color Extractor: click any part of the image to set the color to key.
vs_chroma_key.use_when: Keys one texture over another by distance from a chosen color. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] invert [boolean] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.] color [r g b a] // float 0. - 1.. Use vs_clr_xtrct to pick the key color by clicking the image. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_clr_solid.digest: Generates colors in the rgba format.
vs_clr_solid.use_when: Generates a solid-color texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: out; dumpout. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] color [r g b a] in floats 0. - 1.. Color takes r g b a floats from 0 to 1. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_clr_xtrct.digest: Click on any part of the Color Extractor Preview to get the color in that point.
vs_clr_xtrct.use_when: Outputs the color of the pixel you click in its preview. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Data Output - Color. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] size [small, medium, large]. Outputs data, not a texture; feed it to vs_chroma_key or a colorizer. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_colorizer.digest: Tints a texture with a specific color.
vs_colorizer.use_when: Tints a texture with one chosen color. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Data Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] color [r g b a] // floats 0. - 1. hue [0. - 360.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_colorizer_2.digest: Implements HSL and Pedestal controls, and Hue-Saturation modulation.
vs_colorizer_2.use_when: Adjusts hue, saturation, lightness and pedestal, with hue and saturation modulation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Hue Modulation In; Sat Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] hue [0. - 360.] saturation [-2. - 2.] [-10. - 10.] light [0. - 2.] [0. - 10.] pedestal [-1. - 1.] hm +-[0.1 / 1 / 3] sm +-[2 / 5]. Modulation inputs take textures. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_comparator.digest: Set brightness to their maximum or minimum amount depending on a threshold.
vs_comparator.use_when: Pushes pixels to full or zero brightness around a threshold. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [boolean] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Smooth softens the cut. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_convolve.digest: Implements a 3x3 convolution kernel. Some classic convolutions are already available in the menu.
vs_convolve.use_when: Applies a 3x3 convolution kernel, with a menu of classic kernels. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Kernel. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] r0/r1/r2 [f f f] width [0. - 1.] kernel [0 - 11]. Kernel rows can also be set by message. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_cos_palettes.digest: Generates 7 different gradients of color. It can also cycle through it to get a solid color and colorize incoming texture.
vs_cos_palettes.use_when: Generates cosine color gradients and uses them to recolor an image. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Gradient In (Override). Outlets: Color Generator Out; Colorizer (Tint) Out; Gradient Map Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] sync_invert [boolean] time [0 - 10] mode [boolean] phase [-1. - .1] palette [1 - 5]. Three outputs: gradient, solid color, and a gradient map of the input's brightness. A second inlet can override the gradient, for example from jit.gradient.ui. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_crssfade.use_when: Crossfades between two textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In 1; Texture In 2. Outlets: Texture Out; Dumpout. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] crossfade [0. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_degrader.use_when: Reduces the number of color levels (posterizes) a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] active [boolean] steps [0. - 255.] mode [boolean]. Since v1.7 set by color count 0-255; older presets may load differently. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_differentiator.digest: Absolute difference between actual frame and previous frame.
vs_differentiator.use_when: Outputs the difference between the current and previous frame. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Shows only what moves; still images go black. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_displacement.digest: Apply simple spatial transformations and texture modulation inputs.
vs_displacement.use_when: Moves, rotates and zooms a texture with texture modulation inputs. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; X Modulation In; Y Modulation In; Angle Modulation In; Zoom Modulation In. Outlets: unlabelled. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] x [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] y [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] xm [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] ym [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] rotm [-6.28 - 6.28] zm [-1. - 3.] a_lock [boolean] kmode [boolean] mmode [boolean] angle[0. - 360.] zoom [0. - 5.] boundmode [0 - 3]. Separate modulation inputs for X, Y, angle and zoom; several warp modes. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_dither.use_when: Dithers an image with an 8x8 ordered Bayer pattern. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] scale [0. - 1.]. Scale sets pattern size. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_duotoner.digest: Splits the image into 2 brightness sections and colorize each independantly. It implements two different modes.
vs_duotoner.use_when: Colors the dark and light parts of an image with two chosen colors. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] c1 [rgba] // float 0. - 1. c2 [rgba] // float 0. 1 - 1. mode [boolean] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Sharp or smooth mode. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_edges.digest: Based on Gaussian High-pass and Comparator modules.
vs_edges.use_when: Detects edges using a high-pass filter and a threshold. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Built from vs_filter_hp4x and vs_comparator. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_envelope.digest: It creates a simple AD envelope.
vs_envelope.use_when: Generates an attack-decay brightness envelope when triggered. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: unlabelled. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] attck [0. - 1.] [0. - 4.] dcay [0. - 1.] [0. - 4.] bang. Trigger with bang; attack and decay times are settable. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_envelope_follower.digest: Transform audio energy into both a texture and a number.
vs_envelope_follower.use_when: Turns audio loudness into a texture and a number. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Audio In / Control In. Outlets: Video Out; Number Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): on [boolean]. Useful for audio-reactive brightness. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_fader.digest: Changes the brightness intensity of a texture.
vs_fader.use_when: Changes the overall brightness of a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] fader [0. - 1.5] clip [boolean]. Clip keeps values within 0-1; fader goes up to 1.5. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_feedback.digest: Plug&Play videofeedback-chain made with the "max" operator for quick trails and other effects.
vs_feedback.use_when: Adds a video feedback loop for trails, using a max operation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] amt [0. -1.]. Amt sets trail length. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_filter_hp4x.use_when: Sharpens and extracts edges with a Gaussian high-pass filter. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25]. Cutoff 0-0.25. Useful for taming noisy feedback and for edge detectors. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_filter_lp2x.use_when: Blurs a texture with a two-pass Gaussian low-pass filter. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25]. Vs_filter_lp4x blurs more at higher cost. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_filter_lp4x.use_when: Blurs a texture with a four-pass Gaussian low-pass filter. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25]. Smoother but heavier than vs_filter_lp2x. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_filter_spat.use_when: Filters a texture spatially in low-pass, high-pass or band-pass mode. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25]. Four passes; cutoff 0-0.25. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_filter_temp.digest: Smooth and enhace borders based on the differentiation between the actual and previous frame. Since this process involves time, the processor won't operate if your image is still.
vs_filter_temp.use_when: Filters a texture over time, splitting slow and fast changes. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: LowPass Texture; HighPass Texture. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] cutoff [0. - 0.25]. Separate high-pass and low-pass outputs. Does nothing on a still image. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_fish_eye.use_when: Applies a fisheye lens distortion to a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] aperture [0. - 180.]. Aperture 0-180. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_flip&swap.use_when: Mirrors a texture horizontally or vertically, or swaps its axes. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] invx [boolean] invy [boolean] swap [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_frame_delay.use_when: Delays video by a number of frames, with mix, feedback and random playback. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mix [0. - 100.] feedback [0. - 1.] playback [1 - 3] d_time [1 - 70]. Up to 70 frames; v1.7 added reverse playback. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_hsl_modulator.digest: Implements HSL and Pedestal controls, and HSL texture modulation inputs.
vs_hsl_modulator.use_when: Adjusts hue, saturation and lightness, each with a texture modulation input. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Hue Modulation In; Sat Modulation In; Light Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] hue [0. - 360.] saturation [-2. - 2.] [-10. - 10.] light [0. - 2.] [0. - 10.] pedestal [-1. - 1.] hm +- [0.1 / 1 / 3] sm +- [2 / 5] lm +- [-1. - 1.]. Includes a pedestal offset. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_hue_rot.digest: Shift Hue manually or with another texture.
vs_hue_rot.use_when: Rotates the hue of a texture by hand or by another texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Hue Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] hue [0. - 360.] hm +- [0.1 / 1 / 3]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_huemod_2.digest: Same as Hue Modulator 1 with Saturation control.
vs_huemod_2.use_when: Rotates hue and sets saturation, with texture hue modulation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Hue Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] hue [0. - 360.] saturation [-2. - 2.] [-10. - 10.] hm +- [0.1 / 1 / 3]. Same as vs_hue_rot plus saturation. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_inverter.digest: When a texture is connected to the modulation input the knob becomes an attenuverter.
vs_inverter.use_when: Inverts a texture's colors by hand or by a modulating texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Invert Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] inv [-1. - 1.]. With a modulation texture connected, the knob becomes an attenuverter. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_lfo.digest: Texture & Data LFO with basic waveforms.
vs_lfo.use_when: Generates an LFO waveform as both a texture and a control number. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Data Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] waveform [0 - 5] freq_range [boolean] freq [0. - 1.] [0. - 10.] pw [0. - 100.]. Six waveforms; freq_range switches slow and fast ranges. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_luma_key.digest: Key based on distance from a luminance value
vs_luma_key.use_when: Keys one texture over another by brightness. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] invert [boolean] threshold [0. - 1.] smooth [0. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_3.use_when: Adds up to three textures with level controls. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] in1 / in2 / in3 / master [0. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_3_avg.digest: Spits the average texture of 3 different sources. It needs the 3 sources to work.
vs_mixer_3_avg.use_when: Averages three textures into one. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): master [0. - 1.]. Needs all three inputs connected to work. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_6.use_when: Adds up to six textures with level controls. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3; Texture In 4; Texture In 5; Texture In 6. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] in1 / in2 / in3 / in4 / in5 / in6 / master [0. - 1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_fdbk.digest: Add together 3 textures and boost the overall brightness with an internal additive feedback.
vs_mixer_fdbk.use_when: Adds three textures and boosts brightness with internal feedback. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3. Outlets: Feedback Mix Out; Pre Feedback Mix  Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] in1 / in2 / in3 / fdbck / master [0. - 1.]. Outputs both the pre-feedback and feedback mixes. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_spat.digest: Divide the screen in 4 sections to spatially mix the incoming textures.
vs_mixer_spat.use_when: Splits the screen into four areas, each showing a different texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3; Texture In 4. Outlets: unlabelled. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] sync_lock [0 - 3] time [0 - 10] sync_invert [boolean]. Movement follows the sync timer. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_mixer_spat2.digest: Divide a texture in up to 4 sections and replace each with a different incoming texture.
vs_mixer_spat2.use_when: Replaces up to four sections of a texture with other textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; Texture In (Step 1); Texture In (Step 2); Texture In (Step 3); Texture In (Step 4). Outlets: Texture Out; Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] sync_lock [0 - 3] speed [-5. - 5.] offset [-1. - 1.] key [1 - 4] sync_invert [boolean]. Added in v1.7. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_modules.digest: The only officially supported way of adding modules is through this custom menu. To grab it, right-click on an unlocked patch and PasteFrom/Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat.
vs_modules.use_when: Shows the menu of Vsynth texture modules for adding them to a patch. A menu patch, not a processing module. Vsynth's supported way to add modules is Paste From > Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_noise_2.digest: Interpolable and Resizable White Noise based on [jit.noise].
vs_noise_2.use_when: Generates resizable white noise with optional interpolation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] x [x_resolution] y [y_resolution] speed [0. - 10.] mode [boolean] interp [boolean]. X and y set noise resolution; speed sets refresh rate. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_noise_3.use_when: Generates animated, resizable pseudo-random noise on the GPU. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] x [x_resolution] y [y_resolution] mode [boolean] speed [-2. - 2.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_noise_s.digest: Simple white noise module based on [jit.noise]
vs_noise_s.use_when: Generates simple full-frame white noise. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_offset.digest: Generates a constant level of brightness texture.
vs_offset.use_when: Generates a flat gray texture at a set brightness, plus the value as data. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Data Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] value [0. - 1.]. Useful as a constant for mixers and operators. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_offset+rot.digest: Apply simple spatial transformations like translation, rotation and dilation.
vs_offset+rot.use_when: Moves, rotates and zooms a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] x [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] y [-0.1 - 0.1] [-0.5 - 0.5] [-3 - 3] angle [0. - 360.] zoom [0. - 5.] bound mode [0 - 3] a_lock [boolean] ang_range [0 - 5] x_range [0 - 3] y_range [0 - 3]. Several edge-wrapping modes; no modulation inputs (see vs_displacement). Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_op1.digest: Operations between a texture and a scalar value. Applies to all RGB planes.
vs_op1.use_when: Applies a math operation between a texture and a number. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] op [0 - 7] val [float. depending on which operator]. Op picks the operation; applies to all RGB planes. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_op2.use_when: Applies a math operation between two textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control; Texture In 2. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] op [0 - 9]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_output.digest: Hover the mouse on the elements to see their function
vs_output.use_when: Shows a texture in the output window as a corner-pinnable layer. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: none. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] aspect [boolean]. Usually one per patch; several stack as layers. Drag corners for projection mapping. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_pixelator.use_when: Pixelates a texture by lowering its resolution. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] bypass [boolean] interp [boolean] dim [x_resolution] // max 1280. Dim sets horizontal resolution, up to 1280. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_pixelator_2.use_when: Pixelates a texture with separate horizontal and vertical resolution. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In / Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] bypass [boolean] interp [boolean] dim [x_res-y_res]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_pixelator_nonSquare.use_when: Pixelates a texture into non-square shapes, four modes. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [1 - 4 ] dim [1 - 320]. Added in v1.7. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_poltocar.use_when: Remaps a texture from polar to Cartesian coordinates. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Pairs with vs_cartopol. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_preview.use_when: Shows a texture in a resizable preview inside the patch. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. Passes the texture through, so it can sit in the middle of a chain. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_preview_floating.digest: < Embedded patcher to override server name with user input.
vs_preview_floating.use_when: Shows a texture in a separate floating window. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. The window name can be changed and is saved with the patch. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_quad_crossfader.digest: Crossfade between 4 textures with an x/y controller.
vs_quad_crossfader.use_when: Crossfades between four textures with an X/Y pad. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In LowL / Control In; Texture In UpL; Texture In UpR; Texture In LowR. Outlets: Texture Out; Coordinates Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] x [0.-1.] y [0.-1.]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_render.digest: Pin vsynth window on top of the rest
vs_render.use_when: Creates the render context and output window that runs all Vsynth texture modules. Vsynth texture system core (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`): it holds the `jit.gl.render` context and `jit.window` that every `vs_*` texture module draws into. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: dumpout. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] fps [0. - 60.] floating [boolean] visible [boolean] border [boolean] interp [boolean] size [xResolution - yResolution] // max 5760 dim [xResolution - yResolution] // max 5760 screen_size [bang] double_click [boolean] // enable fullscreen double clicking the floating window hide_mouse [boolean] // hide pointer after 3 seconds. Exactly one across all open patches; a duplicate causes heavy frame drops and an extra window. Sets fps, window size and texture dim. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb2luma.use_when: Converts a color texture to grayscale. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb2sepia.digest: Converts RGB to the ocher color obtained from the Cuttlefish's ink.
vs_rgb2sepia.use_when: Tints a texture with a sepia tone. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb2yuv.digest: Converts RGB to Luminance, Signed Chroma Blue and Signed Chroma Red.
vs_rgb2yuv.use_when: Converts RGB color to luma and two chroma channels for color effects. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Try with vs_hue_rot for new color schemes. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb_mixer.digest: Colorize red, green and blue inputs 1, 2 and 3 respectively.
vs_rgb_mixer.use_when: Combines three textures as the red, green and blue channels. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In 1 / Control In; Texture In 2; Texture In 3. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] r / g / b [0. - 1.]. Pairs with vs_rgb_swiz for per-channel processing. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb_offstr.digest: Dials behave like an attenuverter or offset depending on whether they have a texture connected to their correspondent input or not.
vs_rgb_offstr.use_when: Moves each RGB channel separately, with texture modulation inputs. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In / Texture In; Rx - Texture In; Ry - Texture In; Gx - Texture In; Gy - Texture In; Bx - Texture In; By - Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] scale [0 - 2] rx / ry / gx / gy / bx / by [0. - 1.] boundmode [boolean]. Knobs act as offsets, or attenuverters when a texture is connected. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_rgb_swiz.use_when: Splits a texture into separate red, green and blue textures. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: Red Out; Green Out; Blue Out. Pairs with vs_rgb_mixer. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_s&h.digest: Takes a sample of the input image and holds it (freezes) over time.
vs_s&h.use_when: Freezes a frame of video when triggered (sample and hold). Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In; Hold Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] bang. Bang captures a new frame. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_s&h_spat.digest: Takes a sample of the input image and holds it (freezes) over time and space.
vs_s&h_spat.use_when: Freezes parts of a frame by area, sample and hold in space. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In; Hold Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean]. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_scope.digest: Displays the brigthness levels over space.
vs_scope.use_when: Graphs the brightness levels across a texture, like a waveform display. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] zoom [0. - 1.] flip [boolean]. Handy for seeing waveform generator output. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_snapshot.digest: Turn on to automatically save images every second.
vs_snapshot.use_when: Saves still images of a texture to the Desktop. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Bang. Outlets: none. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): bang dpi [72 - 96 - 150 - 300 - 600]. Bang saves; auto mode saves every second; dpi sets resolution. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_snapshot_2.digest: Turn on to automatically save images every second.
vs_snapshot_2.use_when: Saves still images with a chosen file name and folder. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: none. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): bang dpi [72 - 96 - 150 - 300 - 600]. Variant of vs_snapshot. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_sources_main.use_when: Offers several test sources (camera, movie, noise, color, oscillator) in one module. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): source [0-4]. For trying things out; source picks the input. Not saved by the Vsynth preset system. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_spout_client.digest: Send and receive textures through Spout. Remember to download the Spout Package to use these modules.
vs_spout_client.use_when: Receives textures from other Windows apps over Spout. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: none. Outlets: syphon client. Windows only; requires the Spout package (jit.gl.spoutreceiver), not installed here. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_spout_server.digest: Send and receive textures through Spout. Remember to download the Spout Package to use these modules.
vs_spout_server.use_when: Shares a Vsynth texture with other Windows apps over Spout. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: none. Windows only; requires the Spout package (jit.gl.spoutsender), not installed here. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_sync.digest: These modules spit messeges to control specific modules and processors such as the waveform-generators, spatial mixer and cos palettes.
vs_sync.use_when: Sends the global sync timer to waveform generators and other Vsynth modules. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Control Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): invert [boolean] time [0 - 10] sync_lock [0 - 3]. Outputs control messages, not textures. Also used to build floating-point control waveforms. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_sync_time.digest: These modules spit messeges to control specific modules and processors such as the waveform-generators, spatial mixer and cos palettes.
vs_sync_time.use_when: Sets the speed and direction of the Vsynth global timer and outputs its count. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Control Out; Timming Count. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): invert [boolean] time [0 - 10] sync_lock [0 - 3]. Outputs control messages, not textures. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_syphon_client.digest: Send and receive textures through Syphon. Remember to download the Syphon Package to use these modules.
vs_syphon_client.use_when: Receives textures from other Mac apps over Syphon. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: none. Outlets: syphon client. Mac only; requires the Syphon package (jit.gl.syphonclient). Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_syphon_server.digest: Send and receive textures through Syphon. Remember to download the Syphon Package to use these modules.
vs_syphon_server.use_when: Shares a Vsynth texture with other Mac apps over Syphon. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: none. Mac only; requires the Syphon package (jit.gl.syphonserver). Server name is saved with the patch. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_title_generator.digest: Generates static and scrolling text. It also implements 3 different modes of auto-typing .
vs_title_generator.use_when: Renders static, scrolling or auto-typed text as a texture. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): align [0-2] font_size [0-15] fontsize [whichever value] spread [0. - x.] mode [boolean] type_mode [0-2] scroll_speed [0.-1.] typer_speed [10-250] scale[0-5] font ["name of the font"]. Three typing modes; font and size are settable. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_transfer_curves.use_when: Remaps pixel brightness through one of 22 transfer curves. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out; Inverted Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] curve [0 - 21] phase [0. - 1.] sync_invert [boolean] time [0 - 10] speed [-10. - 10.] cycles [0. - 10.] inv [-1. - 1.]. Feed it a ramp to see the curve. Added in v1.7. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_vca.use_when: Modulates one texture's brightness by another (video VCA). Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In; AM In. Outlets: Texture. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] bias [0. - 1.] am [0. - 1.]. Formula: in1 * ((in2 * am) + bias). Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_video_monitors.digest: Visualize images as in a waveform monitor, vectorscope, histogram or parade graphs.
vs_video_monitors.use_when: Shows waveform monitor, vectorscope, histogram or parade views of video. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In / Control In. Outlets: Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] mode [0 - 3]. High-resolution mode costs more CPU. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_wavefolder.digest: Try with other waveforms and other kind of textures!
vs_wavefolder.use_when: Folds texture brightness with a full-wave rectifier for doubled patterns. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Texture In. Outlets: Texture Out. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_wfg_2.digest: Creates scrolling lines with different waveshapes. It implements frequency, phase and pulse-width modulation inputs.
vs_wfg_2.use_when: Generates scrolling line patterns with frequency, phase and pulse-width modulation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Frequency Modulation In / Control In; Phase Modulation In; Pulse With Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out; Inverted Texture Out. Control messages (to the leftmost inlet, as listed in its help file): enable [boolean] sync_lock [0 - 3] sync_invert [boolean] time [0 - 10] waveform [0 - 5] freq [0. - 1000.] [0. - 10000.] fm [-1. - 1.] [-5. - 5.] pw [0. - 100.] pwm [-0.5 - 0.5] phase [0. - 1.] pm [-1. - 1.] [-5. - 5.]. The workhorse oscillator; normal and inverted outputs. Follows the sync timer. Vsynth by Kevin Kripper.

vs_wfg_3.use_when: Generates scrolling lines that morph smoothly between waveforms, with modulation. Vsynth texture module (a bpatcher added from the Vsynth menu, `Vsynth/menu/vs_menu.maxpat`); passes OpenGL textures and needs exactly one `vs_render` running in the patch. Inlets: Freq Modulation In / Control In; Phase Modulation In; Pulse Width Modulation In. Outlets: Texture Out; Inverted Texture Out.
